body: I'm unable to reproduce, please provide the commands you are using to build the engine.

I use this to build the engine, this works perfectly and it builds the binary 100% without any issues.

- set DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD_TO_PRERELEASE=1
- set /p SCRIPT_AES256_ENCRYPTION_KEY=<.keys\godot.gdkey
- scons platform=windows arch=x86_64 target=editor

Afterwards i do run this to do the mono glue part, which always worked, but now it errors on those spots with the errors i've shown:

- godot.windows.editor.x86_64.mono.exe --headless --generate-mono-glue modules/mono/glue
- python ./modules/mono/build_scripts/build_assemblies.py --godot-output-dir=./bin --push-nupkgs-local=%NUGET_PACKAGES%\..\sources

Edit: Also I noticed this at the beginning of the mono glue generation:
`WARNING: Unknown command line argument "--generate-mono-glue". User arguments should be passed after a -- or ++ separator, e.g. "-- --generate-mono-glue".`
Did the command for it change?
Edit²: I found out that the given error only happens when using `deprecated = "no"` on the `custom.py`, in case of using `deprecated = "yes"` the error does not occurs.

> I found out that the given error only happens when using `deprecated = "no"` on the `custom.py`, in case of using `deprecated = "yes"` the error does not occurs.

If you are building Godot without deprecated API, you also need to build the .NET assemblies without deprecated API (using the [`--no-deprecated`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/96570) flag). It doesn't look like you are doing that from the commands you listed, it should be something like this:

```
python ./modules/mono/build_scripts/build_assemblies.py --godot-output-dir=./bin --push-nupkgs-local=%NUGET_PACKAGES%..\sources --no-deprecated
```

> Also I noticed this at the beginning of the mono glue generation:
`WARNING: Unknown command line argument "--generate-mono-glue". User arguments should be passed after a -- or ++ separator, e.g. "-- --generate-mono-glue".`
Did the command for it change?

No, this is a false positive due to a recent change: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/98895 (cc @Calinou). It seems the command still works despite the warning.

Edit: I did try it, and it built with few warnings, so it works, but the generating of .cs files part stills gave the errors of things not being found in documentation, are there any flag for the .cs file generation script as well?

> The generating of .cs files part stills gave the errors of things not being found in documentation, are there any flag for the .cs file generation script as well?

Some documentation may reference deprecated API and the compiler will complain it can't find it. But these should be warnings, and can be safely ignored.
